question: As of April 2022, who is the Chairman of Rajya Sabha?
solution:
Correct Answer **Shri M Venkaiah Naidu**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points:__**

 
• **Shri M.Venkaiah Naidu** is the Chairman of Rajya Sabha **(April 2022)**.
 
• **Shri Jagdeep Dhankhar **is the** current Chairman of the Rajya Sabha.**
 
• The Vice President of India is the ex-officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha.
 
• The Rajya Sabha is the upper house of the Parliament of India.
 
• The membership of Rajya Sabha is limited by the Constitution to a maximum of 250 members.
 
• The Vice President of India is the Chairman of the Rajya Sabha.
